component.name: WhisperAloud
component.summary: Dictate text offline with on-device speech recognition

description.p: WhisperAloud turns your voice into text without sending audio anywhere. Speech recognition runs entirely on your computer; an internet connection is only used when you choose to download a model.
Open the window, press the record button or your global shortcut, speak, and the transcription is copied to the clipboard and can be typed into the focused application.

ul.li: Offline transcription with Whisper (faster-whisper) and Parakeet models
Live partial transcripts while you speak with streaming models
In-app model download with progress and an explicit license step
Audio clean-up pipeline: noise gate, automatic gain and peak limiter
Global shortcut through the desktop's shortcut portal
Automatic clipboard copy and optional paste into the focused window
Searchable transcription history with favorites and export

screenshot.caption: Choosing and downloading a speech model

description.p: Engine choice, streaming dictation and sandbox support.

ul.li: Pick a speech model from Settings; the matching engine is selected automatically
Parakeet models for much faster transcription on the CPU
Live partial transcripts while recording with the Nemotron streaming model
Download models from inside the app, with progress and cancel
The background service now starts on demand when the window opens
Paste and global shortcuts work through desktop portals when sandboxed

description.p: Background service with a D-Bus control interface and history.
